failure.cause: Reducing checkpointed float32 cross-entropy from 64 predictors to one produced the identical allocation failure, falsifying the CE-workspace diagnosis. The peak is in the live long-sequence activation graph.

rejected_resolutions: Full native saved-tensor CPU offload previously triggered the Linux host OOM killer.
Allocator cache release alone does not reduce the live backward graph.
Single-predictor checkpointed float32 CE does not change the failed allocation.
decision: This is an execution failure, not a benchmark or model-quality result. Selectively offload only large non-leaf saved CUDA activations above a signed byte threshold, keep parameters and small tensors on GPU, validate exact gradients, stress-test the failed row, and restart Stage 1 from exact R12.
